title: East Nashville House | Five Points | Shelby Park
description:
Cozy space with all the amenities you need. Located in east Nashville in close distance to restaurants, bars, breweries, and parks.

**Note the shower is small and may not be suitable for everyone. It measures about 98 in x 28  x 28. See pics.

• Fast WIFI
• Great for individuals, families, mellow groups
• Keyless Entry
• Washer/Dryer
• Audio Receiver w Bluetooth
• Free Parking
• Projector
• Backyard

Excessive energy usage will be an additional charge. Enforced only once in 100+ host bookings.

The space
Within 1 mile you can find...

The Wild Cow
Five Points Pizza
Noble's Beer Hall
Frothy Monkey
Duke's
Edley's BBQ
Smith & Lentz Brewing and Pizza
Lipstick Lounge
Basement East
Rosemary & Beauty Queen
Shelby Park
A grocery store, a convenience store, you get the idea...

***Note the shower is small and may not be suitable for everyone. It measures about 98 in x 28  x 28. See pics.

The house has 2 bedrooms and 1 bathrooms. The open living room has a wall-mounted smart TV connected to a Hifi receiver setup. You can connect your music via Bluetooth.

The kitchen is outfitted with all the cookware you need to prep a good meal. You'll find coffee, tea, and spices in the cupboard.

Both bedrooms have queen sized beds. The blue bedroom is outfitted with a projector.

The large backyard is all yours where you'll find adirondack chairs and a firepit.

Permit #2022035807

Guest access
The home office will be locked during your stay. Otherwise, the rest of the house is yours.

Other things to note
There are security cameras at both house entrances. We will have all notifications turned off during your stay as we have zero interest in keeping tabs on you.
